svg.title: Which pages the accessibility check opens
svg.desc: A push to main and the run of each week open every page and keep a digest of the website in the cache. A pull request restores that digest. Without one, or when a stylesheet, a script, mkdocs.yml, the accepted violations or the tools differ, it opens every page, and otherwise only the pages that differ. A serious or critical violation that .github/a11y-accepted.toml doesn't accept fails the check docs.
